comments.author: parksy333
comments.body_html: Would you be able to include a few more BepInEx sliders/choices for customization? If you could make it so we can adjust the size of the numbers as well as removing the solid background from the display, and possibly allow us to change the color/transparency of the text, that would be amazing. As it is now, the display takes up far too much room in zoom and that solid background box is distracting as can be, obscuring too much of the picture. I love this mod and turn it on when long-distance sniping, but those options would make this so much better and make it so that I can leave it on at all times. A hotkey for toggling it on/off would be extremely useful, as well.
